risk.mae: exact average absolute error rational string

fit_bank.heads: file reference to heads43.json, a dict keyed candidate_id with {fit,head,deployment}
fit_bank.affine_rows: list of exact model43.affine_configs() entries present in this bank
fit_bank.baseline_rows: list of exact baseline configs plus payload:{path,sha256,bytes}, pickle_sha256, pickle_bytes; each gzip-compressed protocol5 pickle is retained
fit_bank.final_bank_rule: Only final selected candidates are fitted; the unchanged18-map factory is still run, but only needed maps/training features are retained. Complete factory metadata is retained.

fit_seal.closure: All bank files for all3seeds, excluding later validation files and the seal itself

validation_predictions.candidate_predictions: dict keyed candidate_id with {reported_physical_hex:[...],exact_physical:[...] or null}
validation_predictions.maps: dict map name to retained validation-feature array reference

selection_seal.closure: Selected roster, all9selection files and all final fit-bank files/seals

query.predictions: flat dict all18seed::policy keys -> {candidate_id,evaluation_id,reported_physical_hex}; affine entries also exact_physical
query.evaluations: ID is affine::deployment_id for affine, or baseline::digest({candidate_id,pickle_sha256}) for baselines; deduplicate identical IDs; each has recipe,candidate_id,aliases,reported_physical_hex,fit_bank reference; affine also deployment,features,map,assay
query.assay: model43.prediction_assay result with binary64 and float32 reported-value conditions
query.ordering: Every query prediction file is immutable before data43.reveal_assessment_target reads the target

assessment.primary_comparisons: ordinary and ridge each {raw_risk,reference_risk,mse_ratio or null,within_five_percent_mse}
assessment.certificate_summary: Counts over deduplicated actual evaluation identities/query pairs, separate from alias-level coverage

misbinding.rule: After complete assessment, challenge every unique selected certified deployment on query0; stale features are fixed query1 for that deployment; identical bytes remain not applicable

cost.rule: seed3901 selected identities; m=min(32,n), indices floor((2j+1)n/(2m)); full inference pair order alternates sample ordinal; all primitive raw timings and sizes retained

result.rule: Aggregate fixed policy risks, exact primary conjunction, certificate assays and actual costs. Validity requires separately bound final independent audit PASS.
